request.query: Studies of the UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset or comparable e-commerce session data that compare marginal purchase rates across product-page depth or page-count groups with covariate standardization, stratification, or common-support adjustment for visitor type, traffic source, month, and weekend.
request.missing_relation: Whether a session-depth-to-purchase contrast decomposed into marginal and context-standardized components has already been studied, and how overlap and session-level dependence were handled.
request.change_if_found: If a close study performs this decomposition, revise toward a distinct, testable extension supported by the supplied fields or withdraw novelty implications; absence from returned metadata leaves novelty unverified.
